run_evals: run a population evaluation across multiple agent types with a specified number of games and seed
get_games_from_folder: load completed game objects and their power-to-agent mappings from a directory of game JSON files
get_power_scores_from_folder: extract flattened power scores for all agents across all games in a results directory
get_power_scores_from_folder_grouped_by_: extract power scores grouped by individual game from a directory of game result files
launch_population: launch missing evaluation game jobs locally or on SLURM using a list of seeds and agent mappings
